Major Anchors: Publix, Dollar Tree, Marshalls, Krispy Kreme, Subway, Wells Fargo, and many more. It is located right next to the Publix entrance on a bustling intersection with a very high traffic count. The above budget price includes all equipment and ancillary products, architectural/engineering drawings, and construction costs.

This remodeled and retooled laundromat is built in a 1,900 square foot in line shopping center space. The center is anchored by a Sedano's Supermarket. The store will be equipped with Huebsch Galaxy leading-edge, energy efficient washers and dryers, which offer the utmost in convenience and saves you money and helps the environment and you never have to wait for a dryer. Save on included impact fees and mechanical infrastructure in place, plus complete remodeling and brand new equipment.

Rare opportunity to acquire a long-standing, established laundromat with strong historical presence in the market. This business is being offered at an asking price of $1,025,000 and includes the installation of brand new Speed Queen washers and dryers, creating an appealing turnkey opportunity for an operator or investor looking for a quality laundry asset with immediate upside. The purchase structure is designed to be accessible, with an approximate down payment of $200,000, subject to finance approval.

Sunbelt Business Brokers of Baton Rouge is excited to present this exceptional opportunity to own a thriving laundromat in a prime location in Metro Baton Rouge. Established location with updated equipment; accepts both cash and pre-paid digital cards. Additional revenue from vending machines and paid event parking.

This offering is a new vended laundry project package for a 3,500-square-foot free-standing location and includes brand new Speed Queen laundry equipment and a comprehensive installation/build-out scope through SLE under a separate equipment purchase and installation agreement. Factory-direct financing through Speed Queen Financial Services has been approved for the project (subject to buyer qualification and lender underwriting). SLE is offering an equipment/build-out package, and any lease assignment is offered separately by an affiliate, subject to landlord approval.

A fully equipped coin laundry in a desirable coastal community. Operates 24/7 with no on-site attendant required. Stable revenue of approximately $100,000/year with owner's discretionary earnings in the $20,000-30,000 range after addbacks.
